name: Uniswap V4
description: Uniswap v4 inherits all of the capital efficiency gains of Uniswap v3, but provides flexibility via hooks and gas optimizations across the entire lifecycle

methodology.Revenue: Fee switch enabled on 27 Jul 2026 (tracked in uniswap-v3 adapter), a part of fees collected to buy back and burn UNI.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fee switch enabled on 27 Jul 2026 (tracked in uniswap-v3 adapter), a part of fees collected to buy back and burn UNI.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Part of fees distributed to LPs after protocol cut. (It was 100% of fees before fee switch(27 Jul 2026)).
methodology.Volume: Swap volume, excluding wash trading: pools whose daily trades come from too few distinct addresses to be organic, unless every pool token is a core asset or CoinGecko-listed.
